SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score,

    SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id

JOIN order_reviews r
  ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC, review_count DESC

per_question.question: What is the top product category?
answers:
```sql
WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY

)
SELECT product_category
FROM category_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, product_category ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

per_question.question: How many new customers were there in 2018?
answers:
```sql
WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_date
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers_2018
FROM first_orders
WHERE strftime('%Y', first_order_date) = '2018';
```

This counts customers whose earliest order was placed in 2018.
[rows]
52062

```sql
WITH first_order_by_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_timestamp
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers_2018
FROM first_order_by_customer
WHERE SUBSTR(first_order_timestamp, 1, 4) = '2018';
```

This counts unique customers whose earliest order occurred in 2018.
[rows]
52062

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2018-01-01'
       AND MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) < '2019-01-01'
) AS first_orders_in_2018;
```
